itemIds.title: Item IDs
itemIds.description: Taobao / Tmall numeric item ids, or 1688 offer ids. Found in the listing URL: item.taobao.com/item.htm?id=600530677383.

itemUrls.title: Item URLs
itemUrls.description: Listing URLs instead of ids. Taobao, Tmall and 1688 links are all accepted; the id is read out of the URL.

keyword.title: Search keyword
keyword.description: Search the catalogue instead of naming ids, e.g. 蓝牙耳机 or bluetooth earbuds. Results are capped by Max products.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Which catalogue to read. Affects the URL built for each record and the fields that apply (wholesale ladders and minimum order quantities are a 1688 concept).

quantity.title: Order quantity to price
quantity.description: How many pieces you intend to order. Each record then carries a quote: the unit price at that quantity resolved against the wholesale ladder, the subtotal, which tier it landed on, and whether the quantity clears the seller's minimum. Leave empty to skip.

maxProducts.title: Max products
maxProducts.description: Hard cap on products returned in this run. Each product returned with data is one billable event.

includeSkus.title: Include the SKU matrix
includeSkus.description: On: return every purchasable variant with its own options, price and stock. Off: keep records small and return the listing level only.

concurrency.title: Listings fetched at once
concurrency.description: How many listings to fetch in parallel. Higher is faster; lower it if your provider plan has a tight rate limit. Requests stay spaced by the interval below however many workers run.

minRequestInterval.title: Minimum seconds between requests
minRequestInterval.description: Spacing between calls to the data provider, enforced across all workers. Raise it if your provider plan has a tight rate limit. The default suits a standard plan.

sourceBaseUrl.title: Product data provider base URL
sourceBaseUrl.description: Leave empty to use the included data source. Set this only if your organisation requires listings to be fetched through its own provider contract.

sourceApiKey.title: Product data provider key
sourceApiKey.description: The key for the provider above. Ignored when the base URL is empty.
